comment: C-first source candidate for zap.c:weffects(SPE_DRAIN_LIFE) -> bhito -> drain_item. A debug Wizard is raised to level 20, wishes a +1 dagger, drops it, moves one tile east, then uses #wizcast to send Drain Life west through the dropped object. C must confirm wish/drop/menu inputs, direction, object hit/resistance and the actual drain outcome; a miss remains a valid target miss.
